jobs.title: Head of User Acquisition
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

We are redefining how User Acquisition (UA) works across our group. As Head of User Acquisition, you will lead a high-performance department delivering UA-as-a-Service to all our product teams. You will centralize operations, drive efficiencies, and establish a unified strategy across all paid traffic channels. You will also mentor and manage a distributed team of expert UA Managers across our portfolio, while acting as the key strategic and operational bridge between product, creative, and analytics. This is a high-impact leadership role suited for someone who thrives on scale, complexity, and data-driven execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead the centralized User Acquisition Department servicing multiple subscription products

  • Define and own the overall UA strategy across all platforms (Meta, TikTok, Google, Snapchat, Pinterest, etc.)

  • Develop scalable processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), testing frameworks, and reporting systems

  • Design UA OKRs/KPIs for both department-wide success and individual team members

  • Manage and mentor a team of cross-platform UA Managers embedded in different product teams

  • Lead hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management processes across the UA function

  • Create a high-talent-density culture that fosters performance, collaboration, and growth

  • Oversee large-scale budget management across all platforms and products, ensuring efficient CAC and positive ROAS

  • Develop and implement strategic growth plans based on LTV:CAC ratios, retention, onboarding conversion, and ARPU

  • Partner with data science to create and refine advanced analytics and attribution models

  • Own the testing roadmap: A/B tests, geo-expansion, channel scaling, creative iteration

  • Collaborate with Managing Directors of each product to align UA strategies with business goals

  • Work closely with creative leads to guide ad production using data-driven creative briefs

  • Own vendor relationships with major advertising platforms / agencies and tools

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in performance marketing, with 3+ years in a senior leadership role overseeing UA at scale

  • Strong background in subscription-based D2C products, ideally across multiple verticals

  • Proven track record managing multi-million dollar monthly paid budgets

  • Highly organized, data and results-driven leader with experience directly managing and developing a team of at least 5–7 UA professionals. 

  • Deep platform knowledge: Meta, TikTok, Google, Pinterest, Snapchat, and other paid social/search/display

  • Experience building and scaling teams, setting KPIs, and leading under a centralized structure

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with fluency in tools like Tableau, Google Analytics,, and Excel/SQL

  • Relentlessly driven, high-energy operator who thrives in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment

  • Hands-on leader with a “first in, last out” mentality — always engaged, deeply involved, and fully accountable

  • Extremely high standards and low tolerance for poor execution — demands excellence across all levels of the team

  • Obsessed with performance, ROI, and rapid iteration — always pushing for better, faster, and more efficient results

  • Strong management instincts: knows how to hire, coach, and develop A-players while holding teams accountable

  • Commercially obsessed — understands that UA is a growth engine and thinks like a profit-focused entrepreneur

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

  • Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

  • Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

  • Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

  • Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

  • Technical Interview (60 minutes)

  • Final Interview (60 minutes)

Life at Ruby Labs

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognise those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more-more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

#LI-Remote

jobs.title: Google User Acquisition Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

At Ruby Labs, we are at the forefront of innovation, crafting cutting-edge consumer products that shape the future. Our diverse portfolio spans the health, education, and entertainment sectors, offering exciting opportunities to make a real impact. Our dynamic teams are the driving force behind our success, and we’re always on the lookout for passionate individuals eager to join us on this journey of transformation.

About the role

We're seeking a results-driven Google User Acquisition Manager at one of Ruby Labs' fastest-growing companies. You'll manage substantial advertising budgets across 30+ regions, optimizing Search, Display, PMax, and Demand Gen campaigns at scale.

This role is for someone ready to bring their expertise, work intensively, and grow with us. We need autonomous decision-makers who manage their path to success independently while preparing clear weekly strategies. You should take complete ownership of our ad accounts with meticulous attention to performance and growth.

If you're motivated by big budgets, challenging targets, and want a growth opportunity in a high-performance environment, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Peak Performance Execution: Deliver exceptional daily performance across Google Search, Display, PMax, and Demand Gen campaigns with relentless focus on ROI optimization and profitability maximization across 30+ regions.

  • Advanced Data Analysis & Autonomous Decision-Making: Conduct in-depth daily analysis of all campaign data, diving deep into performance metrics to uncover insights others miss. Utilize all available data to autonomously decide which countries and GEOs to scale, prioritizing maximum ROI and most effective budget allocation on a daily basis.

  • Campaign Mastery: Launch, test, and aggressively scale Google Ads campaigns while optimizing every aspect - keywords, targeting, bidding, and budget allocation - to consistently squeeze absolute maximum potential from every campaign.

  • Continuous Innovation & Competitive Intelligence: Proactively research new tools, platform updates, and optimization techniques while analyzing competitor strategies to maintain our competitive edge and discover untapped growth opportunities.

Qualifications

  • Proven Track Record: Minimum 4 years of hands-on Google Ads experience with demonstrated ability to scale budgets profitably and achieve exceptional ROI performance across multiple regions.

  • High-Budget Expertise: Demonstrated experience managing significant monthly ad spend ($100K+) across Search, Display, PMax, and Demand Gen campaigns with consistent profitability and growth results.

  • Multi-GEO Management: Experience managing campaigns across multiple countries and regions with proven ability to make autonomous scaling decisions based on performance data.

  • Data Mastery: Advanced analytical skills with Google Sheets proficiency (pivot tables, SUMIFS, VLOOKUP) and ability to build custom analysis models. Proven track record of diving deep into performance data to uncover insights that others miss.

  • Technical Expertise: Comprehensive understanding of Google Ads account structure, keyword research tools (Ahrefs, Google Keyword Planner), and advanced campaign optimization techniques.

  • Autonomous Decision-Making: Self-driven individual who thrives under pressure, makes independent strategic decisions, and consistently exceeds targets in fast-paced, results-oriented environments.

  • Growth-Oriented: Demonstrated hunger for continuous learning, scaling challenges, and building something big. Ready to work intensively and grow with an aggressive, high-growth company.

  • Communication Excellence: Excellent English communication skills for data analysis, strategic reporting, and presenting performance insights to management.

Nice to have

  • Experience with YouTube Ads and YouTube Shorts Ads

  • Consumer products background

  • Previous experience in subscription-based business models

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

  • Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

  • Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

  • Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

  • Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

  • Technical Interview (90 minutes)

jobs.title: Project Owner
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

We are looking for a Project Owner who is more than a project manager - you are the operational backbone of a fast-moving product team. You will own delivery, structure, and process quality across all teams, while actively automating and optimizing how the team works using AI tools.

This role is for someone who is obsessed with efficiency, thinks in systems, and uses AI not as a buzzword but as a daily execution tool. You will work in Notion end-to-end - task boards, documentation, reporting, and automation - and be expected to continuously improve how the team operates.

If you need to be told what to fix, this role is not for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Delivery & Execution Ownership.
    Ensure every initiative has a clear owner, deadline, and definition of done. Track delivery continuously - planned vs. done, blockers, risks. Surface issues early and drive resolution without escalation.

  • Board & Process Hygiene.
    Own Notion task boards end-to-end - grooming, status accuracy, task naming, labels, ownership. Enforce consistency across all teams. Boards must reflect reality at all times.

  • Task Quality Control.
    Maintain a Definition of Ready standard - every task must have a clear description, acceptance criteria, owner, and dependencies before it enters a sprint. Audit weekly. Reject tasks that don't meet the bar.

  • AI & Automation.
    Actively automate repetitive processes using Notion AI, AI agents, and workflow automation tools. Build systems that reduce manual work across reporting, task management, documentation, and cross-team coordination. Agentic team management approach is a strong plus.

  • Reporting & Visibility.
    Build and maintain lightweight reports on velocity, delivery, and team output. Weekly summaries for leadership - progress, blockers, risks, next steps. No surprises.

  • Daily Syncs & Weekly Cycles.
    Run daily team syncs - every team member starts the day knowing exactly what they're working on, what's blocked, and what's expected by end of day. Own the weekly cycle end-to-end: planning, mid-week check-in, results review. The operational team must have full visibility into execution status and daily progress at all times - no ambiguity, no surprises.

  • Meeting Follow-ups & Accountability.
    Track all action items from standups, retros, and planning sessions. Every item has an owner and deadline. Follow up mid-cycle. Close the loop before the next meeting.

  • Cross-Team Coordination.
    Bridge Product, Engineering, CRO, and Analytics. Ensure requests become actionable tickets. Synchronize priorities across tracks. Prevent misalignment before it becomes a problem.

  • Documentation & Knowledge Management.
    Own the central documentation hub in Notion - templates, release logs, sprint summaries, process documentation. Information must be structured, current, and accessible to the whole team.

  • Process Optimization.
    Continuously identify inefficiencies in how the team operates and propose improvements. You are expected to make the team faster and less chaotic every sprint.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Project Manager, Project Owner, or Operations Lead in a fast-moving product team.

  • Deep, practical knowledge of Notion - task boards, databases, automations, Notion AI. This is our primary tool.

  • Strong hands-on experience with AI tools - Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, Notion AI, AI agents, workflow automation. Expected to use these daily to increase personal and team output. Agentic team management approach is a strong plus.

  • Experience building and enforcing structured delivery processes - Definition of Ready, sprint cadences, reporting standards.

  • Exceptional attention to detail - you catch what others miss.

  • Proactive problem solver - you don't wait for instructions, you find the chaos and fix it.

  • Strong written communication - clear, concise, no fluff.

  • Comfortable managing multiple workstreams simultaneously without losing control.

  • Able to operate effectively in a high-pace, high-pressure environment where things change fast.

  • Experience working with cross-functional teams - product, engineering, growth, analytics, marketing.

  • Fluent Russian language proficiency, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

  • Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

  • Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

  • Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1tzxGX4Uu7Ts_HCLFXESKLnKaaBfVCPf1f9AYZPrkjJM/preview?tab=t.0

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

  • Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

  • Technical Interview (60 minutes)

  • Final Interview (60 minutes)

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/


ABOUT THE ROLE

Ruby Labs is hiring an experienced Senior Data Analyst to join our fast-paced and rapidly growing team for our new product - job application platform, that streamlines the job search process for professionals.

In this role, you'll collect, categorize, and analyze data to create actionable reports that drive decision-making across the company. You'll uncover insights, identify growth opportunities, establish key benchmarks, and ensure we deliver a product that truly satisfies our customers' needs.

We expect you to take full ownership of data pipelines, analytics, and insights – ensuring every decision is backed by reliable data. You'll work in a professional and dynamic environment where accuracy matters, constantly validating that our data is meaningful and actionable.


WHY JOIN US

 - Work on an outstanding product: Our platform is trendy, fast-scaling, and redefining how people change their professional roles.

 - Make a direct impact: As a Senior Data Analyst, your insights will guide product decisions, influence the roadmap, and shape user experiences.

 - Tackle meaningful challenges: From decoding user intent across millions of interactions to optimising conversion funnels, you’ll face complex and exciting problems every day.

 - Grow with us: This is an ambitious journey with huge potential – perfect for someone eager to grow alongside a cutting-edge product and market.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Partner with Product Owners and Data Teams.

 - Create new dashboards, maintain and improve existing reports such as Product Reports.

 - User behaviour analysis, aha moment analysis

 - Analyse data to generate actionable insights, find trends, patterns and provide recommendations to maximise KPIs.

 - Monitor metrics.

 - Designing and building robust data models in SQL.

 - Give and receive actionable feedback to and from peers and the Leadership Team.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - Degree in an analytical field such as Math, Data Science or Economics.

 - At least 3+ years of work experience as a Data Analyst.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify trends, patterns, and insights in large datasets.

 - Excellent verbal communication.

 - Ability to think strategically and make data-driven decisions that align with the organisation’s goals.

 - Experience in Product Analytics.

 - Experience with Mixpanel, GA4, Amplitude or similar.

 - Advanced SQL.

 - Experience with popular BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or similar.

 - Experience in subscription business.

 - Ability to adapt quickly, learn new tools and methods efficiently, and work effectively in a high-pressure, fast-changing environment.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Strong spoken and written English.

 - Experience in Marketing Analytics.

 - Experience with Python, R.

 - Experience with GCP, BigQuery.

 - Experience with Google Ads, Facebook Ads etc.

 - Experience with orchestration frameworks such as Airflow.

 - Experience with git and code review process.


LOCATION

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.


BENEFITS

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

 - Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

 - Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

 - Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

 - Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

 - Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!


INTERVIEW PROCESS

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

 - Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

 - Technical Interview (60 minutes)

 - Interview with Head of Product (60 minutes)

 - Final Interview (60 minutes)


LIFE AT RUBY LABS

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

jobs.title: Recruitment Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

Are you a driven recruiter with a sourcing superpower? Join Ruby Labs as a Recruitment Specialist and play a key role in rapidly scaling our tech and product teams! This is a pure talent acquisition role—not HR or People Ops—where your primary focus will be on proactively and creatively sourcing, engaging, and securing top-tier performers.

You will collaborate closely with hiring managers to attract talent across high-growth areas, including Engineering (focused on backend languages like Golang, and specialized areas like Data and QA), Product, and Marketing/Growth. The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic, high-impact environment and is excited by the opportunity to earn performance-based bonuses for hitting hiring targets.

We are particularly focused on the Eastern European market. Direct experience and market knowledge of the EE talent landscape is essential, and the ability to communicate in Ukrainian or Russian is a significant advantage.

Key Responsibilities

  • Proactively identify and engage high-quality passive candidates using LinkedIn and a variety of other sourcing platforms.

  • Efficiently manage high-volume candidate pipelines and ensure meticulous data integrity using our ATS – Ashby.

  • Conduct initial recruiter screenings, specifically assessing candidates for roles like Backend Developers, Full-Stack Developers, Data Analysts/Engineers, QA Engineers, and various Growth/Product Specialists.

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with hiring managers to deeply understand specific technical and cultural requirements for each open role.

  • Provide timely, professional, and positive feedback to all candidates, ensuring a smooth process that reflects well on the Ruby Labs brand.

  • Collaborate with the Recruitment team to continuously optimize sourcing strategies and recruitment workflows for maximum speed and efficiency.

  • Stay informed about industry trends and competitor strategies within the Eastern European tech market.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of dedicated recruitment experience in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, preferably within a high-growth tech company.

  • Proven track record in sourcing and closing technical roles, including backend, frontend, data, and growth positions.

  • In-depth market knowledge of the Eastern European talent pool is required.

  • Proficiency with advanced sourcing techniques and platforms beyond standard job boards and basic LinkedIn usage.

  • Familiarity with well-known ATS platforms (e.g., Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, etc.).

  • Exceptional organizational skills, a keen eye for detail, and the ability to effectively manage multiple, competing priorities under tight deadlines.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

Nice to have

  • Fluency or strong proficiency in Ukrainian or Russian.

  • Experience hiring for specialized roles like Golang, Head of User Acquisition, or CRO/Growth.

  • Familiarity with the technologies and tools used by our teams, including Next.js, React, TypeScript, Node.js, Nest.js, Mixpanel, GA4, Amplitude, SQL, Python, R, GCP/BigQuery, Google Ads, and Facebook Ads.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

  • Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

  • Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

  • Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

  • Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

  • Take-Home Assessment

  • Final Interview (60 minutes)

Life at Ruby Labs

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

We’re looking for a Senior or Lead Data Analyst with deep experience in subscription billing analytics and strong technical skills in ClickHouse (and ideally Tinybird). You will own analytics for billing and payments: build and optimize datasets and queries, define billing metrics, and deliver dashboards that product, finance, and operations teams rely on daily.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain data pipelines in Tinybird and ClickHouse to power dashboards and self-serve analytics.

  • Optimize ClickHouse queries for performance, correctness.

  • Design and maintain core billing metrics: gross/net revenue, refunds, chargeback rate, dispute rate, approval rate, churn, LTV, MRR/ARR, and cohort retention.

  • Create and iterate on dashboards/visualizations for internal stakeholders (Billing/Finance/Product/Support/Risk).

  • Investigate anomalies and data-quality issues (e.g., spikes in refunds, rising dispute rates, drops in approval rates), perform root-cause analysis, and propose actions.

  • Partner with engineering on data instrumentation and event tracking to ensure high-quality billing data.

  • Document logic (metric definitions, tables, pipeline behavior) and establish quality checks (tests/monitoring).

Qualifications

  • Strong subscription billing experience is mandatory (payments + renewals + refunds + disputes/chargebacks).

  • Advanced SQL (complex joins, window functions, incremental logic, performance-aware query writing).

  • Production experience with ClickHouse: query tuning and data modeling for analytics workloads.

  • Experience building basic ETL/ELT pipelines (scheduling, incremental loads, validation, monitoring).

  • Git workflow (PRs, code review, versioning of SQL/data logic).

  • Strong experience building dashboards and visualizations (BI tools or internal dashboards) with a focus on business clarity and metric correctness.

  • Ability to communicate findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to have

  • Tinybird experience (pipes, endpoints, materializations, performance tuning).

  • JavaScript (dashboard integrations, or data apps).

  • Python (for analysis/automation), dbt, Airflow(or other orchestration).

  • Experience in risk/fraud analytics.

  • Experience with experimentation A/B tests.

Location

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

We are looking for a Head of UX/UI Design (Engineer) who will take full ownership and final responsibility for UI/UX quality across the entire product.

This is a senior, high-impact role for an exceptional specialist. You will be the main authority on UI/UX, responsible for ensuring that every interface, flow, and interaction shipped to production is clear, modern, intuitive, and aligned with best UX practices.

All UI/UX-related changes must be reviewed and approved by you before release. You are fully accountable for the UX that reaches users.

In this role, UX in this role is created directly in code. Instead of producing static mockups, you will assemble and demonstrate your design solutions using Tailwind and existing UI components, collaborating closely with Product, CRO, and Engineering to turn ideas into production-ready UX solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Final UI/UX Ownership

    • Act as the final decision-maker for all UI/UX changes across the product. Nothing related to UI/UX goes to production without your approval.

  • Code-First UX Design & Implementation

    • Build and demonstrate UX solutions directly in code using Tailwind and reusable UI components. You are expected to independently assemble layouts, states, and flows in a structured way to clearly communicate your design decisions to the team.

  • Exceptional UI Quality & Clarity

    • Deliver clean, modern, minimalistic, and intuitive interfaces that follow UX best practices and reduce cognitive load for users. Every element must serve a clear purpose.

  • UX Ideation & Product Contribution

    • Generate and develop UX ideas aimed at improving usability, clarity, engagement, and overall product value.

  • UX Flow & Interaction Design

    • Define and refine user flows, screen logic, interactions, and states to ensure a smooth and predictable user experience.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration

    • Work closely with Product Managers, CRO Managers, and Engineers to translate hypotheses into clear, testable, and scalable UX solutions.

  • UX Quality Control

    • Ensure UX implementation is consistent, well-structured, and requires minimal rework after release.

Qualifications

  • Highly senior Product UI/UX Designer / UX Engineer with a deep understanding of both UI and UX.

  • Practical ability to write frontend code at least at a junior level. You must be comfortable assembling full pages and flows using Tailwind and component-based systems without relying on designers or mockups.

  • Strong product thinking: you understand how UX decisions affect user behavior, retention, and value.

  • Experience with subscription-based or performance-driven products is a strong plus.

We operate with exceptionally high standards for product quality and user experience. Every product change is expected to deliver a clear, intuitive, and frictionless experience — our goal is not incremental improvement, but consistently exceptional user experience.

  • End-to-End Product Ownership
    Own product initiatives from idea → UX definition → development → testing → production release, ensuring high quality at every stage.

    Ensure that all product changes are coherent, well-thought-out, and aligned with the overall product vision.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

At RubyLabs, we’re seeking a Senior AI Engineer (Node.js / Next.js / TypeScript) to shape our AI infrastructure and drive production-ready LLM experiences. You’ll work in a modern stack, making data-driven decisions around model performance, reliability, and cost.

You’ll own advanced prompt systems, structured outputs, and complex LLM workflows using LangChain or LlamaIndex. Observability, debugging, and evaluation are core to the role, leveraging Langfuse and AI gateways like OpenRouter to continuously improve model quality and operational efficiency. You’ll take full ownership of key AI features from experimentation to live production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced Prompt Engineering: Designing complex, dynamic prompt templates with conditional logic and efficiently reusing information and context within prompts to maximize generation quality and reasoning.

  • Structured Outputs & Schemas: Implementing various response schemes (JSON mode, function calling, Zod/JSON schemas) to ensure AI outputs are predictable and ready for seamless integration into application logic.

  • Prompt Engineering & Evaluations: Building robust evaluation pipelines and using Langfuse to collect feedback and score the quality of responses in real time.

  • Tracing & Debugging: Performing deep debugging of complex LLM chains using Langfuse traces to identify bottlenecks and optimize for cost, latency, and context window usage.

  • AI A/B Testing: Running systematic experiments across different models via OpenRouter (e.g., comparing Claude 3.5 Sonnet vs. GPT-4o) and analyzing results based on quantitative metrics.

  • Data-Driven Decisions: Making deployment decisions for new prompts or models strictly based on quantitative benchmarks and trace data, rather than intuition.

  • Output Scoring & Analysis: Developing scoring systems to analyze the “Problem → Solution” chain and identify root causes of hallucinations or logic errors using Langfuse analytics.

  • Model Performance & Fine-Tuning: Regularly re-evaluating model performance as new architectures emerge and performing fine-tuning when necessary to meet specific domain requirements.

Qualifications

  • Node.js & Next.js: Deep knowledge of the stack to build reliable services and handle complex LLM-generated data.

  • Dynamic Prompting Skills: Proven experience in building prompts where content is highly dependent on input variables and context injection.

  • OpenRouter Experience: Experience working with unified APIs, managing rate limits, and selecting the most cost-effective models for specific tasks.

  • Langfuse (or similar): Understanding of LLM observability principles — setting up tracing, creating test datasets, and integrating scoring systems.

  • Evaluation Methodology: Experience with frameworks like RAGAS or building custom “LLM-as-a-judge” systems.

  • Analytical Mindset: Ability to transform raw generation logs into actionable business metrics and technical insights.

  • Iterative Mindset: Focus on continuous product improvement through constant feedback loops.

Nice to have

  • Fine-Tuning: Practical experience in fine-tuning models for specific domain tasks or JSON compliance.

  • RAG Architecture: Understanding how to build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems, including indexing, retrieval, and re-ranking.

  • Python: Basic knowledge for working with data science scripts or AI evaluation libraries.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

  • Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

We are looking for a Marketing Growth Manager to join our Growth team at use.ai, one of Ruby Labs’ fastest-growing AI portfolio companies. This role owns and scales the entire paid user acquisition and creative testing engine, with direct accountability for CPA, conversion volume, and revenue growth.

This is a hands-on, execution-heavy role for someone passionate about performance marketing, creative experimentation, and data-driven growth. You will own the full funnel, from creative concept ideation through aggressive campaign scaling, acting as the bridge between creative production and performance marketing. You will work closely with the Lead Ad Creative Producer and serve as the final performance authority before campaigns scale to significant spend.

The ideal person for this role thrives in high-autonomy, high-expectation environments and is motivated by shipping fast, testing relentlessly, and scaling what works.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the entire creative testing funnel, from concept generation to winner identification.

  • Design and execute a high-velocity growth engine with zero downtime in creative testing.

  • Continuously generate and test 15–30 creatives in parallel, producing and validating 50+ concepts per day using AI tools.

  • Define winners strictly (≥100 conversions in a single day at target CPA) and kill underperforming concepts quickly.

  • Initiate aggressive scaling of validated concepts through creative, CTA, visual, actor/avatar, and environment variations.

  • Launch parallel localization across priority languages (DE, FR, ES, IT) and emerging markets.

  • Maintain CPA discipline during scale, including blended CPA across cold traffic and retargeting.

  • Build and manage retargeting campaigns contributing 10%+ of total conversion volume.

  • Execute and optimize campaigns across Meta, Google Display and Performance Max, Google and Bing retargeting, and emerging channels (TikTok, Reddit, X, AppLovin).

  • Maintain strict asset naming conventions and campaign organization.

  • Own creative and performance analytics, including daily reviews, centralized tracking, and rolling performance reports.

  • Track CPA, CVR, ARPU, and LTV projections to ensure healthy unit economics.

  • Build and maintain automation workflows for creative performance tracking with 12-hour update cycles.

  • Translate performance insights into actionable creative direction for producers.

  • Collaborate daily with UX researchers and data teams to identify new persona and avatar opportunities.

  • Provide direct, detailed feedback to creative teams and ensure concepts target real, high-intent adult use cases.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, or paid user acquisition.

  • Proven track record scaling Meta and Google campaigns profitably to $5M+ per month.

  • Direct experience managing high-volume creative testing pipelines (50+ concepts per month).

  • Strong experience with subscription or SaaS products; consumer AI products are a strong plus.

  • Experience managing multiple brands or campaigns simultaneously, ideally in an agency or multi-product environment.

  • Expert-level proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and analytics platforms.

  • Strong understanding of the Andromeda algorithm, where creative signals outweigh targeting controls.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools for creative production (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude, Midjourney, DALL·E).

  • Strong prompt engineering skills for AI-generated images and videos.

  • Advanced data analysis skills, with the ability to extract insights and make fast decisions.

  • Experience with automation tools such as N8N or Zapier.

  • Clear, direct communication style and exceptional attention to detail.

  • Highly execution-driven, data-oriented, and comfortable with ambiguity and rapid change.

Nice to have

  • Experience scaling campaigns across emerging paid acquisition channels.

  • Deep familiarity with Meta compliance and approval processes.

  • Experience building performance tracking systems or custom growth dashboards.

  • Background in high-growth consumer subscription businesses.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

We are expanding our Marketing Department and looking for a meticulous, results-driven Localizations Manager to lead localization operations across all Ruby Labs brands.

This full-time role will manage the end-to-end localization process across 30+ languages, ensuring that all translated assets sound 100% native, maintain product and brand integrity, and directly contribute to measurable performance improvements across marketing funnels and in-product experiences.

You will own a localization workflow powered by Lokalise, AI tools, and cross-functional collaboration with brand managers, product managers, and developers. You’ll ensure high-quality translations, maintain consistency across product ecosystems, and help drive conversion improvements by adapting content for global audiences.

This is a high-impact role reporting directly to the Marketing Director.

Key Responsibilities

  • Localization Management: Oversee all translations of websites, email campaigns, ad creatives, funnels, and marketing assets across 30+ languages using Lokalise + AI tools.

  • Native-Level Quality: Ensure all localized content reads naturally, culturally fits the target market, and avoids literal or machine-sounding translations.

  • AI-Driven Workflow: Leverage Lokalise, AI models (e.g., ChatGPT, DeepL, Manus AI), and internal guidelines to achieve high-quality outputs.

  • Performance & Quality Monitoring: Evaluate the impact of localized content on conversion rates, user engagement, and product experience across different markets.

  • Project Management: Own timelines and deliverables across multiple brands and languages. Prioritize tasks and communicate effectively with stakeholders.

  • UI/UX Awareness: Ensure translations are visually compatible with web layouts. Maintain readability and design integrity across all languages.

  • Collaboration: Work cross-functionally with brand managers, designers, copywriters, and developers, to ensure a seamless user experience in all languages.

Qualifications

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in localization or translation of marketing and product content at scale.

  • Hands-on experience with Lokalise (must-have).

  • Strong experience using AI-powered translation tools (ChatGPT, DeepL, Manus AI, or similar).

  • Proven project management skills across multiple languages and stakeholders.

  • Strong marketing and cultural adaptation insight—understanding how tone, messaging, and nuance differ across markets.

  • Strong awareness of UI/UX considerations for multilingual products.

About the role

We are looking for a Head of User Acquisition to take full ownership of execution quality, operational processes, and performance delivery within the User Acquisition Department.

This is a hands-on leadership role, you will manage a team of 3–6 User Acquisition Managers across different seniority levels and will be fully accountable for the team’s KPIs, execution discipline, ROI, and results.

You are expected to build strong operational processes, maintain high execution quality, and actively participate in performance management. This role requires deep hands-on expertise - not theoretical leadership.

This is a high-impact, high-responsibility role. Results, efficiency, and ROI are the primary measures of success.

  • Team Leadership & Development
    Lead, mentor, and develop a team of User Acquisition Managers. Ensure continuous growth in knowledge, execution quality, and performance across the team.

  • Hands-On Performance Management
    Stay deeply involved in daily operations. Be able to step into ad accounts at any moment to diagnose issues, optimize performance, launch campaigns, and demonstrate best practices.

  • Budget Ownership at Scale
    Manage and oversee $1M+ monthly advertising budgets across all networks, ensuring disciplined spend allocation, controlled scaling, and performance stability.

  • Facebook as a Core Channel
    Be exceptionally strong in Facebook Ads or Google Ads, taking full responsibility for Facebook Ads as the primary acquisition channel.

    Work deeply with performance data and analytics to identify insights, inefficiencies, and growth opportunities. Collaborate closely with the Analytics team to stay continuously informed about funnel performance, attribution, cohort behavior, and overall acquisition efficiency.

  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to work deeply with data to extract insights.

  • Experience collaborating closely with Analytics teams to guide decision-making.

About the role

We’re looking for a Mid-Level Full-Stack Developer to join our product engineering team and help us build, scale, and improve our QR code generator web SaaS. In this role, you’ll work hands-on across the full stack using Next.js on the frontend and Node.js on the backend, contributing to the development of complex features that directly impact users and business outcomes. You’ll collaborate closely with Product, Design, and other Engineers to turn requirements into clean, scalable, and secure solutions.

This is a product-focused role in a fast-moving environment. The SaaS product is already live and growing rapidly, so your work will immediately go into production and be used by real users worldwide. While you won’t be expected to lead the team or define architecture alone, you’ll be trusted to take ownership of features, follow best engineering practices, and continuously improve how we build and ship software.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building end-to-end features, cares about code quality and performance, and wants to grow within a strong engineering culture.

Key Responsibilities

  • Full-Stack Development: Take an active, hands-on role in developing complex features and modules using Next.js for the frontend and NodeJS for the backend.

  • Quality Assurance: Enforce best practices in coding, testing, caching, and performance monitoring to ensure a robust and scalable application.

  • Security: Design and implement comprehensive security measures at the application, infrastructure, and data levels.

  • Analytics & A/B Testing: Experience working with analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, PostHog, Mixpanel) and platforms for A/B testing.

About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

At RubyLabs, we’re seeking a senior AI Engineer (Node.js / Next.js / TypeScript) to shape our AI infrastructure and drive production-ready LLM experiences. You’ll work in a modern stack, making data-driven decisions around model performance, reliability, and cost.

You’ll own advanced prompt systems, structured outputs, and complex LLM workflows using LangChain or LlamaIndex. Observability, debugging, and evaluation are core to the role, leveraging Langfuse and AI gateways like OpenRouter to continuously improve model quality and operational efficiency. You’ll take full ownership of key AI features from experimentation to live production.

Key Responsibilities

  • Advanced Prompt Engineering: Designing complex, dynamic prompt templates with conditional logic and efficiently reusing information and context within prompts to maximize generation quality and reasoning.

  • Structured Outputs & Schemas: Implementing various response schemes (JSON mode, function calling, Zod/JSON schemas) to ensure AI outputs are predictable and ready for seamless integration into application logic.

  • Prompt Engineering & Evaluations: Building robust evaluation pipelines and using Langfuse to collect feedback and score the quality of responses in real time.

  • Tracing & Debugging: Performing deep debugging of complex LLM chains using Langfuse traces to identify bottlenecks and optimize for cost, latency, and context window usage.

  • AI A/B Testing: Running systematic experiments across different models via OpenRouter (e.g., comparing Claude 3.5 Sonnet vs. GPT-4o) and analyzing results based on quantitative metrics.

  • Data-Driven Decisions: Making deployment decisions for new prompts or models strictly based on quantitative benchmarks and trace data, rather than intuition.

  • Output Scoring & Analysis: Developing scoring systems to analyze the “Problem → Solution” chain and identify root causes of hallucinations or logic errors using Langfuse analytics.

  • Model Performance & Fine-Tuning: Regularly re-evaluating model performance as new architectures emerge and performing fine-tuning when necessary to meet specific domain requirements.

Qualifications

  • Node.js & Next.js: Deep knowledge of the stack to build reliable services and handle complex LLM-generated data.

  • Dynamic Prompting Skills: Proven experience in building prompts where content is highly dependent on input variables and context injection.

  • OpenRouter Experience: Experience working with unified APIs, managing rate limits, and selecting the most cost-effective models for specific tasks.

  • Langfuse (or similar): Understanding of LLM observability principles — setting up tracing, creating test datasets, and integrating scoring systems.

  • Evaluation Methodology: Experience with frameworks like RAGAS or building custom “LLM-as-a-judge” systems.

  • Analytical Mindset: Ability to transform raw generation logs into actionable business metrics and technical insights.

About the role

RubyLabs is hiring an experienced Senior Product Data Analyst to join our fast-paced, high-ownership environment. You will drive analytics across subscription products and web funnels, partnering with Product, Marketing (UAM), and Data teams to improve conversion, retention, and LTV—while ensuring trusted tracking, strong data models, and decision-ready reporting.

This role is hands-on and cross-functional: you will own analysis from problem framing to recommendation, and you’ll mentor analysts while collaborating closely with Data Engineering/BI to keep data foundations reliable.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with Product, Marketing, and Data Teams to define KPIs, success metrics, and decision criteria.

  • Create new dashboards, maintain and improve existing reporting (e.g., Product Reports, Marketing Performance Reports), ensuring clarity and trust.

  • Deliver full-funnel analysis, identify bottlenecks, and propose improvements or A/B test ideas.

  • Lead user behavior analysis (journeys, drop-offs, activation/aha moments) using event data.

  • Monitor key metrics and anomalies; escalate issues and communicate updates to stakeholders with defined SLAs

  • Own and maintain event taxonomy and tracking structure (events, properties, naming conventions); validate implementation and business logic alignment.

  • Design and build robust, reusable SQL data models (clean layers, consistent definitions, performance-minded queries).

  • Mentor Junior/Middle Data Analysts in SQL, validation, funnel/cohort analysis, and experimentation quality; provide regular feedback and guidance.

  • Give and receive direct, actionable feedback with peers and the Leadership Team; maintain a high bar for quality in a demanding environment.

Qualifications

  • Degree in an analytical field (e.g., Mathematics, Data Science, Economics) or equivalent practical experience.

  • 3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, with proven ownership of end-to-end analysis and stakeholder delivery.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to identify trends, patterns, and root causes in large datasets.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication; ability to translate analysis into clear business actions.

  • Ability to think strategically and make data-driven recommendations aligned with company goals.

  • Strong experience in Product Analytics: funnels, cohorts, retention, LTV, churn, segmentation.

  • Hands-on experience with event analytics tools: Mixpanel, GA4, Amplitude, or similar

  • Advanced SQL

  • Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Looker, or similar.

  • Experience in subscription business and/or acquisition-driven web funnels.

  • Ability to adapt quickly, learn new tools efficiently, and deliver high-quality work in a high-pressure, fast-changing environment.

  • Strong spoken and written English.

You will drive analytics across subscription products and web funnels, partnering with Product, Marketing (UAM), and Data teams to improve conversion, retention, and LTV—while ensuring trusted tracking, strong data models, and decision-ready reporting.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

We are looking for a QA Engineer (manual-first, API-heavy) to keep a payments platform stable during frequent releases and occasional urgent hotfixes. We don't run strict sprint cycles, so you should be comfortable in a Kanban / continuous delivery setup: clarifying scope, building lightweight test coverage, and shipping fast without breaking critical payment routes.

You will focus on risk-based testing of payment flows, end-to-end API validation (including webhooks), and maintaining pragmatic regression/smoke checklists that balance speed and safety.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manual testing: validate new features, fixes, and hotfixes across Web UI + APIs.

  • Risk-based testing: define test scope based on financial / customer impact; call out residual risks.

  • API / E2E validation: test REST APIs, async flows, and webhooks using Postman/Newman (or equivalent).

  • Data validation: verify state transitions and side effects in PostgreSQL; understand idempotency and retries.

  • Regression ownership: maintain and continuously improve smoke + regression suites for critical payment routes.

  • Incident-to-tests: convert production incidents into new regression cases or monitoring checks.

  • Collaboration: work closely with engineers/PMs to clarify requirements, reproduce issues, and verify fixes.

  • Release reporting: provide concise QA notes per release (scope, result, risks, follow-ups).

Qualifications

  • 3+ years in QA with strong manual testing fundamentals.

  • Strong API testing skills (Postman/Newman, curl, Swagger/OpenAPI).

  • Practical understanding of: auth vs capture, refunds, webhooks, idempotency, retries.

  • Basic SQL (PostgreSQL): ability to validate records, joins, state transitions.

  • Experience with logs/monitoring (Grafana, Kibana/ELK, Sentry or similar).

  • Comfortable in Kanban / no-sprints / fast-changing requirements.

  • Good English (written + spoken) for remote async work.

Nice to have

  • Experience with PSPs (Stripe, Adyen, PayPal, Braintree, Worldpay, etc.).

  • Experience with 3DS flows (frictionless vs challenge) and SCA constraints.

  • Familiarity with test automation frameworks (pytest, Playwright) and CI (ability to read/maintain existing checks is a plus).

  • Understanding of network tokenisation (DPAN / network tokens).

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

RubyLabs is building a payment orchestration system consisting of:

  • A JavaScript frontend SDK for payment forms

  • A Golang backend API

  • An internal CRM

Our platform is integrated into multiple products and workflows, where correct integration, clear documentation, and fast feedback are critical to successful payment processing.

We are looking for an Integrations Engineer who will act as the technical bridge between our platform and the products integrating it. This role combines frontend engineering, integration support, product understanding, and customer-facing communication.

In this role, you will:

  • Work closely with internal and external product teams integrating our payment solution

  • Help products correctly integrate our frontend JavaScript SDK and backend APIs

  • Be deeply familiar with how our system behaves in real-world integrations

  • Feed real integration issues, edge cases, and gaps back to the engineering team

This is not a classic support role — you will write code, read code, debug integrations, and help shape both the SDK and the documentation based on real usage.

About the role

You will be the person who:

  • Helps products embed and configure our payment form SDK

  • Answers integration questions in support channels

  • Tests integrations and reproduces issues

  • Distinguishes bugs vs incorrect usage vs documentation gaps

  • Ensures our documentation matches actual API and SDK behavior

You will work closely with backend engineers, frontend SDK developers, and product managers to improve integration quality and developer experience.

Key Responsibilities

SDK Integration & Customer Support

  • Assist product teams in integrating the JavaScript payment SDK into their frontend applications.

  • Help configure payment flows, callbacks, and error handling.

  • Monitor support channels (Slack, tickets, shared chats, etc.).

  • Answer technical questions related to SDK usage and API behavior.

  • Guide teams through best practices for secure and reliable integrations.

Debugging & Issue Triage

  • Reproduce reported integration issues locally or in test environments.

  • Debug frontend and API-related issues across:

    • JavaScript SDK

    • Backend Golang API

    • CRM and configuration interfaces

  • Identify whether an issue is:

    • A real bug

    • Incorrect integration or usage

    • Missing or unclear documentation

  • Escalate confirmed bugs to the development team with clear reproduction steps and context.

Documentation Ownership

  • Review and validate API and SDK documentation against real system behavior.

  • Keep documentation in sync with current SDK and API versions.

  • Identify missing examples, unclear explanations, or misleading flows.

  • Proactively improve developer-facing docs based on integration feedback.

Internal Tooling & CRM

  • Use and understand the internal Next.js CRM.

  • Help configure products, payment flows, and settings via the CRM.

  • Provide feedback to the CRM team on usability gaps or missing functionality.

  • Occasionally implement small frontend improvements if needed.

Feedback Loop & Product Impact

  • Act as the voice of integrators and product teams inside RubyLabs.

  • Share recurring issues, friction points, and improvement ideas with engineering and product.

  • Help prioritize fixes and improvements based on real-world impact.

  • Contribute to improving overall developer experience of the platform.

Qualifications

  • Strong experience with JavaScript / TypeScript and frontend integrations.

  • Experience working with frontend SDKs or third-party APIs.

  • Ability to read and understand backend APIs (REST, JSON, auth flows).

  • Comfort debugging issues across frontend and backend boundaries.

  • Strong communication skills and ability to explain technical concepts clearly.

  • High ownership mindset — you care about integrations actually working in production.

Nice to have

  • Experience in payments, fintech, or checkout flows.

  • Experience with React / Next.js.

  • Familiarity with Golang APIs.

  • Experience improving developer documentation.

  • Previous experience in a Solutions Engineer, or Integration Engineer role.

How You Work

  • You enjoy working close to real users and real problems.

  • You’re pragmatic and solution-oriented.

  • You can switch between code, docs, and conversations seamlessly.

  • You know when to escalate a bug — and when to fix confusion with a good explanation.

  • You thrive in a remote, fast-moving environment.

 - Be deeply familiar with how our system behaves in real-world integrations

 - Feed real integration issues, edge cases, and gaps back to the engineering team

 - Answers integration questions in support channels

 - Tests integrations and reproduces issues

 - Distinguishes bugs vs incorrect usage vs documentation gaps

 - Ensures our documentation matches actual API and SDK behavior

SDK Integration & Customer Support

About the role

We are seeking a highly creative, results-driven Social Media Manager to lead the organic growth of all our social media channels across multiple Ruby Labs brands. This is a full-time position reporting to the Marketing Director and collaborating closely with our Creative and Marketing teams.

Your mission will be to grow our social media profiles organically and drive trial sign ups for our products. You will own the strategy and execution of our presence across TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Snapchat, and emerging channels. You’ll launch high-impact, engaging content and campaigns designed to attract attention, encourage interaction, and convert audiences into users.

We’re looking for a social media expert who not only understands how to grow reach and engagement, but also how to convert that attention into measurable acquisition and product sign-ups.

Key Responsibilities

  • Social Media Strategy & Execution: Lead the organic social media strategy across multiple Ruby Labs brands and platforms (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Snapchat), with a direct focus on driving organic growth and product trials.

  • Campaign Ideation: Conceptualise and launch viral content campaigns, including giveaways, challenges, collaborations, and community-driven initiatives.

  • Content Calendar Management: Create and manage monthly content calendars for each brand, ensuring strategic alignment, platform-specific optimisation, and timely delivery.

  • Performance Growth: Grow our follower base and engagement while improving social media’s contribution to total product sign-ups and trials. Regularly analyse performance and make data-informed decisions to improve results.

  • Creative Collaboration: Work closely with designers to guide content production and ensure the highest quality output aligned with each platform's best practices.

  • Analytics & Reporting: Track and report on key metrics weekly and monthly. Use data to inform future content and optimize performance.

  • Trend Spotting: Stay up-to-date with the latest platform trends, viral formats, and algorithm changes. Be proactive in suggesting new ideas and testing new platforms or features.

  • Cross-functional Alignment: Collaborate with product teams to align messaging and ensure consistency across channels.

Qualifications

  • Experience: Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience managing social media accounts across multiple platforms with a proven track record of organic growth and engagement.

  • Platform Expertise: Deep understanding of TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube, Snapchat – their audiences, formats, algorithms, and growth strategies.

  • Creative Thinking: Strong ideation skills. Must be a content and campaign brainstormer who knows how to turn ideas into viral content.

  • Execution Excellence: Experience managing content calendars, posting schedules, engagement workflows, and reporting systems.

  • Analytical Skills: Ability to measure performance, identify growth opportunities, and optimize content based on insights.

  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Bonus points for strong visual storytelling and short-form video content experience.

  • Ownership Mentality: Highly autonomous, proactive, and comfortable taking full responsibility for the performance and direction of our social channels.

Nice to have

  • Experience working with subscription-based or digital consumer products.

  • Experience growing accounts from zero to significant following.

  • Strong understanding of content virality and shareability mechanics.

  • Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

This is the role for someone with an AI-driven mindset, comfortable combining structured experimentation, product analytics, and modern AI tools to improve performance across our user funnels and contribute to sustainable product growth.

You will discover optimization opportunities, design and run experiments, and leverage AI-assisted insights to enhance user journeys, increase conversion rates, and support overall product performance.

Working closely with the Senior Growth Manager to execute optimization cycles across multiple funnels, you’ll be involved in every stage of the CRO process - from research and hypothesis development to testing, analysis, and rollout - while focusing primarily on execution quality, organization, and learning.

This is not a role for passive recommendations. You will actively contribute to experiments, ensure they are implemented correctly, and help turn insights into measurable improvements.

  • Track experiment status, results, and learnings across multiple funnels.

  • Maintain and regularly update the experimentation backlog, ensuring priorities, statuses, and documentation are always current.

  • Document learnings and contribute to building a structured experimentation knowledge base.

Our current growth engine relies heavily on Meta and Google, and we are planning to expand into new channels such as Snapchat and TikTok. The role requires both strategic thinking and hands-on execution, with a strong emphasis on scaling profitably, optimizing campaigns, and building repeatable growth systems.

If you are excited about owning large budgets, driving measurable growth, and building scalable acquisition systems in a startup-style environment, this role is for you.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - ROI Maximization
   
   - Develop and implement strategies to continuously improve return on ad spend (ROAS).
   
   - Identify opportunities to scale successful campaigns while maintaining or improving efficiency.

 - Data Analysis & Insights
   
   - Conduct deep analysis of campaign performance metrics.
   
   - Leverage Tableau, Google Ads and Meta reporting, and other tools to extract insights.
   
   - Translate data into actionable strategies and tactical decisions.

 - Campaign Structure & Optimization
   
   - Design and implement optimal campaign/account structures.
   
   - Continuously test and refine ad copy, landing pages, bidding strategies, and targeting.
   
   - Run A/B tests to identify scaling opportunities.

 - Channel Expansion
   
   - Oversee and optimize campaigns across Meta and Google, while testing new growth channels
   
   - Allocate budgets effectively across platforms based on performance and growth potential.
   
   - Stay updated on platform changes and new features, adapting strategies accordingly.

 - Strategy Development
   
   - Collaborate with leadership to establish acquisition goals, KPIs, and budgets.
   
   - Build and execute comprehensive user acquisition strategies aligned with company objectives.
   
   - Continuously refine strategies based on performance data and market trends.

 - Creative Collaboration
   
   - Partner with creative teams to develop high-performing ad creatives.
   
   - Provide data-driven feedback on ad copy and visual assets to improve CTR and conversion rates.

 - Market Research & Growth Experiments
