jobs.title: UI/UX Researcher
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

We are looking for a result-driven Mid-to-Senior UI/UX Researcher to help our team drive conversion improvements across our web product. In this role, you’ll analyze user behavior across the full funnel, conduct competitor and market research, and turn insights into high-impact experiment ideas that directly influence product and business outcomes.

This is a fast-paced, product-focused role where your primary focus will be on audits and hypothesis generation rather than design execution. You’ll work with a high level of ownership, consistently delivering well-structured, data-backed ideas to fuel our experimentation roadmap and support continuous growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct systematic competitor and market research across SaaS, subscription, and freemium products — analyzing user flows, paywalls, onboarding funnels, and conversion patterns.

  • Mine quantitative data from analytics tools (Mixpanel, Microsoft Clarity, GrowthBook) to identify drop-off points, attention gaps, and underperforming screens.

  • Analyze heatmaps, session recordings, and attention data to surface CRO opportunities.

  • Deliver 10–15 experiment ideas per week, each scored using the ICE framework (Impact × Confidence × Ease) with a target threshold of 500+.

  • Write clear, testable hypotheses with defined success/failure criteria and primary metrics.

  • Create low-to-mid fidelity wireframes (AI Tools) to communicate test variants — clear enough for developers and stakeholders to act on.

  • Develop user personas, journey maps, and usability assessments specific to our funnel stages (Landing → Start → Quiz → Analyzing → Email Capture → Checkout).

  • Present insights and recommendations in twice-weekly Growth team brainstorming sessions.

  • Analyze post-test results and extract reusable patterns for the team's knowledge base.

  • Stay current on CRO, behavioral psychology, and SaaS conversion trends.

Qualifications

  • Research Experience: 3+ years in UX research — you've personally run competitor audits, heuristic evaluations, usability studies, and behavioral data analysis (not just visual design).

  • Funnel&SaaS Background: Proven experience with subscription-based or freemium products — you understand recurring revenue funnels, paywalls, and trial-to-paid flows (not just ecommerce/retail).

  • Analytical Toolkit: Fluency with heatmaps, session recordings, and A/B test platforms

  • Prioritization Rigor: Working knowledge of ICE/PIE or similar frameworks for scoring and ranking experiment ideas.

  • Wireframing Ability: Can create low-fidelity prototypes to communicate test concepts.

  • Data Fluency: Comfortable pulling insights from Mixpanel, Google Analytics, Hotjar, or Microsoft Clarity.

  • Communication: Clear, structured communicator who can present ideas to the team twice a week and document findings for stakeholders.

  • Portfolio: Case studies that demonstrate research process and insights — not just final UI designs.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a fast-paced startup or growth team where speed and volume of experimentation matter.

  • Familiarity with behavioral psychology principles (anchoring, loss aversion, social proof, urgency).

  • Basic understanding of front-end implementation - enough to know what's easy vs. hard to build.

  • Experience with AI-assisted research tools and methodologies.

  • Background in EdTech, HealthTech, or self-improvement products.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

  • Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

  • Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

  • Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

We are looking for an International Tax Compliance specialist to join Ruby Labs team and support International Tax Compliance Manager in managing global tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions. In this role, you will play a critical part in ensuring our multinational group meets its tax obligations while identifying opportunities to optimize our global tax position.

The ideal candidate has strong expertise in international tax, a solid understanding of group structures and cross-border transactions, and a proactive, problem-solving mindset. You’ll work closely with finance, legal, and external advisors to optimize tax strategy and support audits across the US, EU, and other key regions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure the company maintains compliance with all documentation requirements for transactions, both intra-company and external, across all jurisdictions in which the company operates.

  • Continuously monitor and optimize the company's tax structure across all operating jurisdictions (currently US, Cyprus, UK) to ensure the most favorable tax treatment.

  • Develop and implement strategies for efficient money flow within the company to minimize tax liabilities while remaining compliant with local and international tax laws.

  • Identify and apply available tax relief instruments, such as tax refund claims under double tax treaties, to maximize tax savings for the company.

  • Stay up-to-date with changes in tax laws and regulations across all relevant jurisdictions and adapt the company's tax strategy accordingly.

  • Conduct regular internal audits to assess the company's tax compliance and identify areas for improvement or potential risks.

  • Provide guidance and support to management and other departments on tax-related matters, ensuring alignment with the company's overall tax strategy.

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all tax-related documentation, filings, and correspondence with tax authorities.

  • Liaise with external tax advisors, auditors, and legal counsel as needed to ensure the company's tax practices are in line with industry best practices and local regulations.

Qualifications

  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in international tax compliance and planning, ideally in a multinational corporate or Big 4 advisory environment.

  • Comprehensive knowledge of international tax laws, transfer pricing, and cross-border transactions.

  • Experience with tax compliance in multiple jurisdictions, especially US, EU, UK.

  • Proven track record in tax structure optimization and tax liability reduction strategies.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

We are redefining how User Acquisition (UA) works across our group. As Head of User Acquisition, you will lead a high-performance department delivering UA-as-a-Service to all our product teams. You will centralize operations, drive efficiencies, and establish a unified strategy across all paid traffic channels. You will also mentor and manage a distributed team of expert UA Managers across our portfolio, while acting as the key strategic and operational bridge between product, creative, and analytics. This is a high-impact leadership role suited for someone who thrives on scale, complexity, and data-driven execution.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and lead the centralized User Acquisition Department servicing multiple subscription products

  • Define and own the overall UA strategy across all platforms (Meta, TikTok, Google, Snapchat, Pinterest, etc.)

  • Develop scalable processes, standard operating procedures (SOPs), testing frameworks, and reporting systems

  • Design UA OKRs/KPIs for both department-wide success and individual team members

  • Manage and mentor a team of cross-platform UA Managers embedded in different product teams

  • Lead hiring, onboarding, training, and performance management processes across the UA function

  • Create a high-talent-density culture that fosters performance, collaboration, and growth

  • Oversee large-scale budget management across all platforms and products, ensuring efficient CAC and positive ROAS

  • Develop and implement strategic growth plans based on LTV:CAC ratios, retention, onboarding conversion, and ARPU

  • Partner with data science to create and refine advanced analytics and attribution models

  • Own the testing roadmap: A/B tests, geo-expansion, channel scaling, creative iteration

  • Collaborate with Managing Directors of each product to align UA strategies with business goals

  • Work closely with creative leads to guide ad production using data-driven creative briefs

  • Own vendor relationships with major advertising platforms / agencies and tools

Qualifications

  • 7+ years in performance marketing, with 3+ years in a senior leadership role overseeing UA at scale

  • Strong background in subscription-based D2C products, ideally across multiple verticals

  • Proven track record managing multi-million dollar monthly paid budgets

  • Highly organized, data and results-driven leader with experience directly managing and developing a team of at least 5–7 UA professionals.

  • Deep platform knowledge: Meta, TikTok, Google, Pinterest, Snapchat, and other paid social/search/display

  • Experience building and scaling teams, setting KPIs, and leading under a centralized structure

  • Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with fluency in tools like Tableau, Google Analytics,, and Excel/SQL

  • Relentlessly driven, high-energy operator who thrives in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment

  • Hands-on leader with a “first in, last out” mentality — always engaged, deeply involved, and fully accountable

  • Extremely high standards and low tolerance for poor execution — demands excellence across all levels of the team

  • Obsessed with performance, ROI, and rapid iteration — always pushing for better, faster, and more efficient results

  • Strong management instincts: knows how to hire, coach, and develop A-players while holding teams accountable

  • Commercially obsessed — understands that UA is a growth engine and thinks like a profit-focused entrepreneur

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

  • Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. About the role

One of the RubyLabs’ portfolio companies is looking for a highly experienced and specialized Senior Growth Product Manager to join our team. The primary focus of this role is to drive top-of-funnel growth through optimizing our funnel stages, leading to user registration and payment. This role requires direct experience in managing and improving web funnels in a B2C.

Key Responsibilities

  • Funnel Optimization: Define and implement hypotheses to improve the conversion rate (CR) to purchase and lifetime value (LTV) within the web funnel.

  • Data-Driven Strategy: Dive deep into data on the competitive environment and user behavior to propose strategies that drive customer acquisition efficiency and improve CPA.

  • Testing Roadmap: Run a robust testing roadmap, driving continuous improvement in the web funnel. You will ensure that strict quarterly KPIs are met and exceeded.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with designers, developers, and other key stakeholders to seamlessly execute optimization strategies, from product requirement documents to execution.

  • Agile Ceremonies: Assist Engineering team in leading agile software development ceremonies, including daily standups, grooming, planning, and retrospectives.

  • Ownership of Results: Lead the entire growth process, taking full responsibility for results, from hypothesis creation to final implementation and evaluation.

  • 4+ years of growth product management experience, specializing in B2C subscription models.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

Ruby Labs is an international holding group with subsidiaries operating across multiple jurisdictions, including the US, Cyprus, Malta, the UK, Singapore, and others. We operate in software development and are seeking a highly capable legal professional to lead and strengthen our legal function as the company scales.

The Senior Legal Counsel role is central to the company's corporate governance, regulatory compliance, substance and defence files preparation, IP management, intra-group structuring, and equity-incentive administration across all jurisdictions of presence.

The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in corporate law with a pragmatic, business-oriented mindset. You will be responsible for ensuring that the group's legal documentation is of the highest quality, that corporate substance is properly evidenced and defensible, and that the group's tax and legal positions are robust in the face of regulatory scrutiny.

Key Responsibilities

  • Draft, review, and maintain corporate governance documents across all group entities (board resolutions, written consents, articles, memoranda, corporate policies, terms etc.).

  • Prepare and maintain intra-group agreements, including but not limited to: intercompany service agreements, licensing and IP agreements, cost-sharing arrangements, management and advisory agreements, loan agreements, business plans and transfer pricing-related documentation (in coordination with tax advisors).

  • Develop and continuously update corporate records, and supporting documentation evidencing each entity's genuine activity and economic substance in its jurisdiction of incorporation / residence.

  • Lead the preparation and ongoing maintenance of comprehensive defence files (economic substance files) for group entities, ensuring they are audit- and enquiry-ready at all times.

  • Ensure the legal dimension of group-wide tax compliance by reviewing, drafting, and optimising contracts and corporate documentation to support and protect the group's transfer pricing and tax positions together with the tax department.

  • Monitor regulatory and legislative changes in all jurisdictions of presence and proactively advise the management on risks and required actions.

  • Manage legal aspects of the company's equity incentive and stock vesting programs—including drafting and administering vesting/share purchase agreements, overseeing share transfers, issuances, and cap table management, obtaining necessary board/shareholder approvals, and ensuring compliance with applicable securities, contractor, and tax regulations across relevant jurisdictions.

  • Manage the group's IP portfolio, including registration, protection, licensing, and enforcement of trademarks.

  • Manage all stages of dispute resolution — from pre-litigation claims and regulatory inquiries through formal proceedings — including drafting responses, instructing and overseeing external counsel, controlling strategy, costs, and timelines, and advising management on dispute risk, settlement, and enforcement options.

  • Build and manage a network of trusted external legal advisors in key jurisdictions; coordinate engagements, control quality and costs.

  • Develop internal legal processes, knowledge management systems, and reporting frameworks.

Qualifications

  • 7+ years post-qualification experience in corporate/commercial law focused on international and cross-border matters.

  • Admitted to practice: Bar, Law Society, or equivalent. (EU, England & Wales, US State Bar, or Singapore are particularly valued).

  • In-house experience at an international holding/group with multi-jurisdictional subsidiaries, or advisory experience from a top-tier firm (Magic Circle, Silver Circle, Big Four legal, reputable international/offshore firm).

  • Working knowledge of both English and US contract/corporate law is required.

  • Proven track record in: intra-group agreements, IP licensing; corporate governance documentation; substance/defence files for tax and regulatory purposes; internal business plans evidencing genuine economic activity; share incentive/vesting schemes and equity documentation; IP rights management (registration, licensing, enforcement, portfolio strategy).

  • Exceptional English legal drafting — clear, precise, commercially sound documents of the highest quality.

  • Strong analytical & strategic thinking — ability to view the legal architecture of a multinational group holistically and identify risks and opportunities.

  • Deep understanding of economic substance requirements (EU ATAD, CRS, BEPS, local substance legislation in Cyprus, Singapore, US, etc.) and working knowledge of transfer pricing principles for intra-group documentation.

  • Excellent project management — ability to handle multiple jurisdictions, deadlines, and external advisors simultaneously.

  • Strong communication skills — ability to convey complex legal concepts to non-legal stakeholders and influence decision-making.

  • High autonomy, ownership, and commercial acumen — a self-driven, solutions-oriented leader who enables the business in a lean team environment.

Nice to have

  • Experience in the tech industry.

  • Familiarity with data protection and privacy laws (GDPR, CCPA, and equivalents),

  • Familiarity with transfer pricing documentation.

  • Experience with M&A transactions (buy-side / sell-side due diligence, SPA negotiation, post-merger integration).

  • Knowledge of AML/KYC regulatory requirements as they apply to corporate group structures.

  • Experience interacting with tax authorities, financial regulators, or government agencies on behalf of an employer or client.

  • Litigation / dispute resolution experience (arbitration, commercial litigation, regulatory proceedings) is a strong plus.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

  • Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

  • Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

  • Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1tzxGX4Uu7Ts_HCLFXESKLnKaaBfVCPf1f9AYZPrkjJM/preview?tab=t.0

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review, which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

  • Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

  • Final Interview (60 minutes)

Life at Ruby Labs

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

This role is not about maintaining a legacy system. It’s about scaling real products used by real users — fast.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

At Ruby Labs, growth is driven by a deep understanding of our users, who they are, what they need, and why they behave the way they do. We don’t guess. We research, validate, and build on evidence.

We are looking for a UX Researcher who will own the research function across our product portfolio. In this role, you will uncover the behavioral patterns, motivations, and friction points that shape how users interact with our funnels, onboarding flows, and core product experiences. Your insights will directly inform CRO hypotheses, product decisions, and design direction.

This is not a support role. You will be a strategic contributor — someone who proactively identifies research opportunities, drives studies end-to-end, and translates findings into clear, actionable direction for product, growth, and design teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and run end-to-end research studies, from scoping and methodology selection to analysis and synthesis. Define the right method for each question, and push back when a study isn't needed.

  • Conduct qualitative research (interviews, usability tests, diary studies) and quantitative research (surveys, card sorting, behavioral data analysis), using tools like Hotjar, Mixpanel, and PostHog to round out findings.

  • Investigate user behavior across acquisition funnels, onboarding flows, paywalls, and subscription experiences — identifying friction, drop-off reasons, and unmet needs that impact conversion and retention.

  • Partner with CRO, growth, and product teams to translate insights into testable hypotheses, validate feature decisions, and integrate research into the development cycle from the start.

  • Synthesize findings into clear, decision-driving reports with concrete recommendations. Present to product, design, and leadership, and maintain a research repository accessible across teams.

  • Translate behavioral patterns into personas, journey maps, and mental models — and champion a user-centered mindset across the organization.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in UX research, product research, or a related role.

  • Strong proficiency in both qualitative and quantitative research methods.

  • Hands-on experience with user testing platforms (UserTesting, Maze, Lookback, or similar).

  • Ability to analyze behavioral data from tools such as Mixpanel, Hotjar, PostHog, or Google Analytics.

  • Experience researching consumer-facing digital products, ideally subscription or funnel-driven.

  • Exceptional ability to synthesize ambiguous findings into clear, prioritized, actionable insights.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communication — you tell stories with data, not just report findings.

  • High ownership mindset: you drive studies from kickoff to decision without needing to be managed.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, fully remote environment with high autonomy.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have

  • Experience in a CRO or growth-focused product environment.

  • Familiarity with A/B testing and experimentation frameworks.

  • Background in behavioral psychology, cognitive science, or human-computer interaction.

  • Experience running research across multiple product verticals simultaneously.

  • Knowledge of accessibility research and inclusive design principles.

  • Experience building or scaling a research function from an early stage.

Location

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

We’re building and scaling a high-growth D2C product used by hundreds of thousands of customers globally, and are now entering a phase where UX becomes a core growth lever.

We’re adding new products, expanding capabilities, and focusing on improving retention, activation, and funnel performance.

We’re looking for a UX Lead who will take full ownership of design, user experience, and research — not as a support function but as a core driver of product and business performance.

Today, design is mostly engineered directly in the frontend, and UX research lacks structure and direction. You will change that.

This is not a 9–5 role. It’s a high-ownership, high-impact position for someone who wants to build systems, lead people, and directly influence product growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Take full ownership of UX, design quality, and user journeys across the product.

  • Define and enforce a clear, scalable design system (even if implemented directly in frontend, not Figma-first).

  • Lead and manage designers and frontend engineers involved in UI/UX work.

  • Turn UX into a measurable growth lever, improving activation, retention, and conversion.

  • Work closely with Product and Growth to design and optimize funnels, onboarding, and monetization flows.

  • Establish a structured approach to UX research, including:

    • defining research priorities,

    • running surveys and interviews,

    • extracting actionable insights.

  • Take ownership of data-driven UX decisions:

    • analyze product analytics (Mixpanel, Clarity, etc.),

    • identify patterns and friction points,

    • define hypotheses and experiments.

  • Proactively request and define new analytics/reporting needs with the data team.

Audit and continuously improve the end-to-end user journey — from acquisition to retention.

What We're Looking For

Core Strengths (Must Have)

  • Design Leadership

    • Strong design background with experience leading or managing designers.

    • Ability to define and maintain a consistent, high-quality design system.

  • UX Research

    • Proven ability to collect both qualitative and quantitative user insights.

    • Experience designing and running user interviews, surveys, and research frameworks.

    • Ability to turn research into clear product decisions.

  • Data & Analytics

    • Strong ability to analyze product data independently.

    • Comfortable working with tools like Mixpanel, Clarity, or similar.

    • Ability to identify patterns, define hypotheses, and request deeper analysis from data teams.

Experience & Mindset

  • 5–8+ years in UX/Product Design, ideally in D2C, SaaS, or consumer digital products.

  • Experience working in fast-paced, growth-oriented environments.

  • Strong understanding of conversion, retention, and user behavior.

  • Systems thinker — designs scalable patterns, not one-off screens.

  • Comfortable working in environments where design is implemented directly in frontend.

  • Clear communicator, able to explain why behind decisions.

  • Strong ownership mindset — you take responsibility for outcomes, not just output.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in LegalTech, document tools, or utility products.

  • Background in CRO (conversion rate optimization).

  • Experience working closely with engineering-led teams.

  • Exposure to A/B testing frameworks and experimentation systems.

Why This Role Matters

  • You will define how UX drives growth, retention, and monetization.

  • You will build the design and research foundation for multiple products.

  • You will work directly with product leadership and influence key decisions.

You will turn UX from a weak point into a competitive advantage.

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

  • Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

  • Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

  • Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/

About the role

We are looking for a Team Lead Developer who will be fully responsible for the technical implementation and product delivery of our platform. This is a hands-on engineering role - you will write code every day, lead and push the development team, and take complete ownership of technical decisions and outcomes.

This role is not for someone who manages from a distance. You are expected to be the strongest technical person in the team, deeply involved in architecture and implementation, and able to think in business outcomes - not just code.

If you are a solution-driven person, this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities

  • Hands-On Development.
    Actively build complex features and modules using Next.js and Node.js. You are not a manager who stopped coding - you are a developer who also leads.

  • Technical Ownership.
    Design system architecture, define the technology stack, and make key technical decisions. You are fully accountable for the quality, scalability, and reliability of the product.

  • Team Leadership.
    Lead, mentor, and push the development team. Run 1-on-1s, conduct code reviews, set high execution standards, and drive continuous improvement in delivery quality and speed.

  • Business Impact.
    Understand product and business goals and translate them into technical solutions that deliver real value. Propose improvements proactively - do not wait to be asked.

  • Process & Delivery.
    Implement and optimize Agile workflows - sprint planning, task estimation, delivery tracking. Ensure the team ships on time without accumulating technical debt.

  • Quality & Security.
    Enforce best practices in coding, testing, caching, and performance monitoring. Design and implement security measures at application, infrastructure, and data levels - including OWASP Top 10, CSP, CORS, and API hardening.

  • AI Integration.
    Research and integrate AI-driven solutions to improve the product and streamline development workflows. Practical experience with AI services (OpenAI API, LangChain, or equivalent) is expected.

  • Analytics & A/B Testing.
    Collaborate with the product team to integrate analytics systems and run A/B tests. Own the technical side of experimentation infrastructure.

Required Technical Skills

  • Next.js - minimum 2 years of active commercial experience with v14.x/v15.x. Must have led at least two projects where Next.js was the primary frontend framework.

  • Node.js - minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with NestJS, Fastify, or Hono. Clear understanding of architectural trade-offs required.

  • Databases - strong proficiency with PostgreSQL and/or Supabase including query optimization and schema design.

  • ORM - deep practical knowledge of Prisma or Drizzle ORM - complex queries, migrations, performance.

  • Caching - strong understanding of caching strategies (in-memory, distributed, CDN) and practical application using Redis or equivalent.

  • Docker - full proficiency with Docker and docker-compose for containerized application management and deployment.

  • AI - practical experience integrating AI services on client and server side. Solid understanding of fundamental AI workflows.

  • Workers & Queues - practical experience with background workers and message queues (BullMQ, RabbitMQ, or equivalent).

  • Security - proven experience building secure systems - OWASP Top 10, CSP, CORS, API security, hosting hardening.

  • Analytics & A/B Testing - experience with analytics tools (PostHog, Mixpanel, GA4) and A/B testing infrastructure.

Leadership & Personal Qualities

  • Minimum 2 years in a Team Lead, Tech Lead, or equivalent role with direct responsibility for a development team.

  • Autonomous - defines what needs to be done without being told, executes without hand-holding.

  • Business-minded - understands product goals and connects technical decisions to business outcomes.

  • Pushes the team - sets high standards, drives accountability, doesn't accept mediocrity.

  • Proposes solutions, not problems - brings options, not blockers.

  • Clear communicator - able to explain technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders concisely.

  • Proactive and highly accountable - owns the product's technical success end-to-end.

  • Fluent Russian language proficiency, with the ability to communicate clearly and professionally.

Nice to have

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).

  • Experience with monorepo tools (Turborepo, Nx).

  • Experience writing unit and integration tests (Jest, Playwright).

Location

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.

Benefits

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

  • Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance.

  • Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days.

  • Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge.

  • Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them.

  • Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!

Interview Process

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

  • Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

  • Technical Interview (60 minutes)

  • Final Interview (60 minutes)

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.
